label: C* for caused movers on the prima via: meaning, unified derivation, retained-state test
summary: Owner request to tackle C* (a caused mover is itself being moved, whenever it moves, in a respect relevant to that moving), the contested load of the absolute First-Way result d337ab29 identified by lane A (PR #1768, accepted after challenge, unmerged; cited as in-flight). Baseline main df4909cb025d2e53fee6071a32defe9cf2721284. Read: the Lean bodies of 1e47e6db, 96da1d33, b3573a61, 226c38f6, f03798ba, d791628f, 0628359b, 777646a5, 8a22ae75 and 446e3f2a; DEF c9798301, 55a974ea, 4a101a4c, c195d490, 04cbb76b, 45595dac, 9f874532, a7904c82 and 211a6432; DISAMB CAUSE, PER-SE-LINK, MOTION and POTENCY; docs/notes/borrowed-exercise-741.md. Materialized and read pinned Physics III.2 (5e66eaa9), III.3 (d0e5f8bf), V.2 opening (93c5b826), ST I q.105 a.5 (915df403) and q.25 a.1 (09369215); every use is an analyst reading and no claim was added. Findings. (1) Meaning: the route needs sense (ii), present enabling dependence (R2: were y not being so moved it would not now be moving x), because the per se regress warrant is instrumental; (i) any change admits the digesting man, (iii) originating dependence gives per accidens series. The R1 modulating reading defeats itself: with 96da1d33 and 226c38f6 it is inconsistent with any reciprocal pair. The standing-power rival targets exactly (ii)/R2 and must concede (i), since a mover moved in no respect would satisfy the absolute conclusion's Lean form. (2) Unification: new open statements 631e014f (non-God-indexed f03798ba), the bridge 7bf380c6 (operation respect is relevant) and e3afc8a3 (b3573a61 for caused movers); 631e014f, d791628f, 0628359b and 7bf380c6 give e3afc8a3 with no axioms, and with the input that an uncaused mover is moved in no respect (2026-11-17 esse-composition inputs) give b3573a61 classically; scratch-checked, not registered. Without the bridge they give only sense (i), which is all 777646a5 and the first-being bridge 74eb9113 use. Manual sense check (no semantics preflight in the installed binary): MOTION_1 and adopted POTENCY_1 throughout; CausesIn at esse only restricts the domain. (3) Test: the teacher (speech, will) and fire (combustion) are confounded, being moved relevantly. Retained-state movers (a hot iron heating wood while cooling; a projectile decelerated by its target) are moved only R2-irrelevantly with no present lender; their reaction supplies b3573a61's antecedent and fails R2; Physics III.2 202a3-7 supports the antecedent, not relevance. Under POTENCY_1 the operation form 631e014f/f03798ba is false of a mover already in act in its operation respects (scratch control). Thomist replies assessed: concurrence (q.105 a.5) is God-indexed and is not MOTION_1 under POTENCY_1; operation as distinct second act (q.25 a.1 ad 2-3) does not give present reduction; conservation is not MOTION_1; virtus impressa is originating; relabelling the cooling as relevant is R1. Rival's independent justification: the physical cases, Physics III.3 202a13-21 and 202a25-b8, V.2 225b10-16 (no motion of agent and patient). Result: a kept counterexample class to universal C* on R2, proposed as a claimed defeat for independent challenge. (4) New: 1e47e6db with 226c38f6 entails that no two distinct beings move each other while each is moved (scratch, no axioms); with the observation premise 4f6ac439 the bundle is inconsistent; 96da1d33 with the regress and a reciprocal pair has a two-element model when the pair's relevance is false. The same pattern applies to 8a22ae75 (not checked). Repair: a series- or respect-indexed per se link, after which the absolute conclusion again needs C*. (5) Scope: instrument C* is well supported and onset C* moderate, but neither suffices; restricting to caused movers gains nothing. A sustaining series (removal test of DEF 4a101a4c) answers the counterexample class at matching scope but yields only a sibling conclusion, a first mediate mover unmoved in every respect, needing a mediate-moving sense and contested by existential inertia. Judgment: universal C* weak; absolute First-Way conclusion through this route weak (proposed revision of PR #1768's moderate grade); relative conclusion e05d2976 unaffected; C* uniquely carries the direct moving edge of an all-respect unmoved first being and the motion-specific naming bridge a594d8c4, not God's existence on the case as a whole.
blocker: Universal C* on its fixed meaning (present enabling dependence, R2) has a kept counterexample class: retained-state movers (a hot iron heating wood while cooling; a projectile decelerated by its target), moved only in respects that do not enable their moving. Its operation-route derivation (631e014f or f03798ba with d791628f, 0628359b and the bridge 7bf380c6) fails under adopted POTENCY_1 for steady exercise, and its non-God-indexed support is missing: concurrence is God-indexed and conservation is not MOTION_1. Separately, the absolute route's premise pair 1e47e6db and 226c38f6 is inconsistent with reciprocal moving (4f6ac439). Next test: compare present conservation of caused beings (the removal test of DEF 4a101a4c) with existential inertia for retained-state movers, and decide whether a faithful mediate-moving sense lets the terminus of a sustaining series count as first mover of the motion. Formal follow-ups: certify the unified derivation, the reciprocity inconsistency and its secunda-via analogue, the steady-exercise and R1 controls and the two-element model; split RelevantTo into enabling and modulating senses; draft a series-indexed per se link.

current_assessment.scope: The commitment C* on the prima via route to GOD_4 exists (8626f8a5, argument ed7c588a): the scope bridge b3573a61, its operation-route derivation (f03798ba, its non-God-indexed restatement 631e014f, d791628f and the bridge 7bf380c6), its caused-mover form e3afc8a3, and the reciprocity observation premise 4f6ac439 that bears on the absolute route's premise pair 1e47e6db and 226c38f6. 8a22ae75 is named as the secunda-via analogue and not reassessed; 1e47e6db, 226c38f6 and d337ab29 are discussed as consumers, not regraded beyond the stated proposal.
current_assessment.assessment: Fixed meaning: C* must be present enabling dependence (sense (ii), relevance R2); the standing-power rival targets exactly this and concedes that its movers change in some respect. 631e014f, d791628f, 0628359b and 7bf380c6 jointly give e3afc8a3 (scratch-checked), so C* is one commitment; without 7bf380c6 they give only the some-respect content that 777646a5 and 74eb9113 use. Universal C* (e3afc8a3, b3573a61) and its operation route are open, blocked by a kept counterexample class of retained-state movers (hot iron, projectile), whose reaction supplies the antecedent and fails R2; under adopted POTENCY_1 the operation form is false of steady exercise; the Thomist replies are God-indexed (concurrence), not MOTION_1 (conservation), originating (virtus impressa) or R1 (self-defeating). Provisional grade: weak, a proposed claimed defeat for independent challenge. Restricted C* for instruments and driven movers is well supported and onset C* moderate; neither suffices for the route. 4f6ac439 (reciprocal moved movers) is an ordinary physical observation under MOTION_1 and makes 1e47e6db with 226c38f6 inconsistent (scratch-checked); any repair of the strong route needs C*. The absolute First-Way conclusion through this route is therefore weakly supported (proposed revision of the in-flight moderate grade of PR #1768); the relative conclusion e05d2976 is unaffected. A sustaining-series reading answers the counterexample class at matching scope but yields only a sibling first mediate mover, needing a mediate-moving sense and contested by existential inertia. C* carries the direct moving edge of an all-respect unmoved first being and the motion-specific naming bridge, not God's existence on the case as a whole. Nothing is established, defeated or closed.
current_assessment.next_test: Compare present conservation of caused beings (the removal test) with existential inertia for the retained-state movers, and test whether a faithful mediate-moving sense lets the unsustained terminus of a sustaining series count as first mover of the motion without passing from direct MovesIn. Formal owner: certify the unified derivation and its classical extension to b3573a61, the inconsistency of 1e47e6db, 226c38f6 and 4f6ac439 and its secunda-via analogue, the steady-exercise and R1 controls and the two-element weak-route model; split RelevantTo into enabling and modulating sense declarations; draft a series-indexed per se link.
